result.description: CRM for sales teams with built-in calling, email, SMS, and an AI teammate to qualify and follow up with leads.
result.auth_detail: API key sent via HTTP Basic (key as username, empty password) for internal scripts; OAuth 2.0 for user-facing integrations. The MCP server also accepts OAuth 2.0 DCR or a Close-API-Key header.
result.access_detail: There is no free plan. Anyone can sign up for a 14-day trial with no credit card. The pricing page says API access is not included on the Solo plan and is included on Essentials, Growth and Scale, so ongoing use needs a paid plan above Solo. OAuth app registration is self-serve in the Close account; no app review was found. I did not fetch the OAuth page, so that part is unconfirmed.
result.api_notes: REST API at https://api.close.com/api/v1. It covers the core CRM objects (leads, contacts, opportunities, activities, and more) plus integration features such as webhooks.
result.blocker: There is no free tier and the Solo plan excludes API access. A developer can use the 14-day trial, but ongoing use needs a paid plan above Solo.

evidence.quote: Close is the CRM with a built-in AI teammate that works with your team to call leads, qualify prospects
